items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. Further reading: The Young'uns - Tiny Notes (Review) Ben Nicholls - Duets

items.body: Review by DimitrisTheHead — There is something about those late '60s/early '70s English albums, in contrast to the American ones, that make them sound epic. Is it the atmosphere? Is it the lyrics? Is it the keys? Is it something else? Maybe it is all these things combined. Now this record, has all that trademark elements of that era, it's bluesy, it's heavy, it's dark in some moments and happy on other moments, it's progy. "Repent Walpurgis" is an amazing instrumental and one of my favorites from that era. Matthew Fisher on the hammond, give me that same feeling, Jon Lord (Deep Purple) or Ken Hensley (Uriah Heep) give me when I'm listening to their records. Yes lads, it is that good.Procol Harum, as a typical British band, decided to leave "A whiter shade of pale" off of the UK vinyl release and put it just on the North America release, plus they left some amazing songs as bonus tracks. (Just listen "Homburg"!!!)A must listen for the fans of that era.
items._genre: crossover prog / psychedelic rock / baroque pop
items._cn_summary: 这张1967年的专辑是英国前卫摇滚的早期作品，融合了布鲁斯、巴洛克流行与迷幻摇滚元素。Matthew Fisher的哈蒙德管风琴演奏被乐评重点提及，与同时代的Deep Purple Jon Lord和Uriah Heep的Ken Hensley形成听觉上的关联。专辑中Repent Walpurgis作为器乐曲被称赞，展现了那个时代英国乐队典型的史诗感氛围。值得注意的是，A Whiter Shade of Pale作为单曲在英国黑胶版本中被剔除，仅收录于北美发行版本，Homburg等曲目也以bonus track形式出现。这张作品在那个年代具有一定的开拓性，但从当代实验音乐视角来看，其编曲和制作手法相对传统，更接近主流摇滚范畴，与用户偏好的实验前卫、爵士、电子等方向距离较远。

items.body: Review by alainPP — An evolving, melodic, synth-driven sound; the track evokes human degradation in the face of AI."Tears Of The Muse" kicks off as a dark, mid-tempo rock track featuring 80s-style keyboards?somewhere between rock, prog, and dark wave. A thunderous beat reminiscent of Genesis and Gabriel gives way to a sharp riff and vocals that trade lines with a vocoder. "EKO" features a hook redolent of Saga?think sugary new-millennium prog-metal with Martin stepping in for Damian. A dash of Arena, a touch of Lalu?it works perfectly for this groovy track with its driving bassline. "I Am The One" features piano accompanying Simon's metronomic drumming. It has a rich, proggy sound?like Toto?complemented by a heavy riff and a solo from Joop. There's a groovy, jazzy, Yes-style break leading into a warm choral finale. "Mayacama" is an instrumental that channels Toto and Saga?I can't help but hear the resemblance. A guitar groove underpins the melody, building into a progressive crescendo with the keyboards following suit. A piano break and a synth-led ballad section precede Joop showing off his dexterity. "Prince With The Swift Warning" features rolling pads and vocal harmonies that add complexity, navigating between rock, pop, and ballad styles. It includes a tense break with a sharp guitar solo, an infectious rhythm, and a second solo that is delicate, bluesy, and proggy."Learning To Fly" features airy vocals and echoes of Saga?or even Marillion. It's an accessible track that surprises with its evolution, while a dark organ keeps the listener on edge. The guitar solo is pure prog, leading into a riff where Martin shows off his impressive vocal range, backed by Simon. The finale soars as Joop and then Vivien drive the track to a spine-tingling climax. "A Drop Of Water" is an acoustic guitar interlude featuring a brilliant, ear-piercing arpeggio?a nod to Steve Howe of Yes. "Fhloston Paradise"?named after the station in *The Fifth Element*?blends hard-hitting rock and vocoder with the energetic, percussive groove characteristic of Joop, reminiscent of Iron Maiden. It features a Yes-style coda, confirming Vivien's admiration for the band. "Cordal Weaves" is a unique track with ethereal, searching notes and a stereo soundscape that creates a distinctly progressive atmosphere. It offers a funky, simmering moment: Martin rallies the energy, Joop lays into the rhythm, and Simon unleashes a barrage of drums. The finale features soaring vocals and a guitar full of melancholic longing. "Midnight Ink" serves as a piano-bar-style closer, driven by a poignant, whispered croon. Melancholic strings lend the track a solemn tone?the perfect way to wrap up the album.A melting pot of mainstream rock in the vein of Saga, Yes, and Toto, created above all for the sheer joy of it. It offers a softer take on prog metal and an intense jazz-prog vibe that feels like a journey in a time capsule.
items._genre: progressive metal / mainstream rock / melodic prog
items._cn_summary: 这是一张旋律驱动的前卫金属专辑，以合成器、钢琴和人声编排为核心架构。曲目在多种主流摇滚风格间切换：开场曲融合了暗潮氛围与80年代键盘音色，后续作品分别借鉴了Saga的流行金属质感、Toto的爵士化摇滚律动以及Yes式的渐进展开。Vocoder处理的人声、合唱段落与吉他独奏构成主要表现手段，整体编曲偏向可听性与旋律流畅度，而非实验性或前卫探索。专辑虽融合了前卫摇滚的经典手法与部分爵士元素，但整体定位偏向主流摇滚与商业化前卫金属，缺乏对实验结构、电子声响或非常规融合的深入尝试。对于偏好实验性、前卫即兴或电子声响的听众而言，此作过于安全与旋律化，距离其期待有较大差距。

items.body: Norwegian gothic industrial metal act Gothminister release the album “We Are All Demons” on 16 October 2026 via Elevator Records, distributed through The Orchard. The 11-track record is the project’s ninth studio album. Frontman Bjørn Alexander Brem recorded, produced, mixed and mastered “We Are All Demons” entirely himself, the first time he has handled the full process alone. Musically, the album combines gothic industrial metal with EDM elements, synthesizers, industrial guitars, theatrical vocals, female duets and choral passages. Lyrically, it addresses inner darkness and the parts of the self normally kept beneath the surface. Tracklist: Darkest Side of Earth We Are All Demons Nightmare King The Dark The Spell Welcome to Hell Salsa My Revenge Darkness Is My Throne Fearless There’s a Crown for All “We Are All Demons” follows the single “My Revenge,” released from the album on 31 July 2026. The album is available for pre-order via The Orchard’s smart link. A digipak CD edition is also listed through Napalm Records’ webshop. Gothminister has confirmed the following live dates around the release: Tour dates for Gothminister’s ‘We Are All Demons’ release 16 October 2026: Fiskepiren, Stavanger, Norway 19 November 2026: Parkteatret, Oslo, Norway 20-21 November 2026: Hellsinki Industrial Festival, Helsinki, Finland More dates are expected to be announced. About Gothminister Gothminister was formed in Oslo, Norway, in 1999 by Bjørn Alexander Brem, who handles lead vocals, programming and instruments. Guitarist Glenn Nilsen is the project’s other current member. The band’s studio discography includes “Gothic Electronic Anthems” (2003), “Empire of Dark Salvation” (2005), “Happiness in Darkness” (2008), “Anima Inferna” (2011), “Utopia” (2013), “The Other Side” (2017), “Pandemonium” (2022) and “Pandemonium II: The Battle of the Underworlds” (2024). Gothminister was also a candidate in Norway’s 2024 Eurovision Song Contest selection, Melodi Grand Prix. “We Are All Demons” follows “Pandemonium II: The Battle of the Underworlds” from 2024 and arrives 16 October 2026 via Elevator Records.
items._genre: gothic industrial metal / EBM / industrial rock
items._cn_summary: 挪威哥特工业金属乐队Gothminister宣布第九张录音室专辑《We Are All Demons》，由主唱Bjørn Alexander Brem独立完成全部制作流程。专辑融合哥特工业金属与EDM元素，叠加合成器、工业吉他、戏剧化人声、女声二重唱与合唱段落。主题围绕内心阴暗面展开，十一首曲目延续乐队一贯的黑暗美学。此前乐队曾参与挪威2024年欧洲电视歌唱大赛选拔。该文为新闻发布稿性质，缺少对音乐本身的深入评析与主观聆听感受，对作品结构、编曲细节及创新程度的探讨有限。整体风格偏商业哥特金属范畴，未呈现明显的实验突破或跨界融合，在用户关注的暗潮与电子交叉领域中属于模式化类型作品。

items.body: Belgian gothic rock band Star Industry will release their 2007 album “Last Crusades” on vinyl for the first time on November 30, 2026, through Alfa Matrix. The LP is limited to 500 copies worldwide, priced at €18.99. ‘Last Crusades’ vinyl: format and tracklist The vinyl edition carries new artwork adapted for the LP format and reproduces the original ten-track album across two sides: A-side: “Lost Generation” “Pray” “Forever” “Out Of My Head” “Sin” B-side: “Last Crusades” “The Return Of David Gun” “Substitudes” “The Spirits Within” “Fall From Grace” “Last Crusades” was Star Industry’s third full-length album, originally released on April 20, 2007, and marked the band’s first release through Alfa Matrix. A digital version remains available on Bandcamp. Last crusades (Bonus Tracks Version) by STAR INDUSTRY Part of the Alfa Matrix Essentials vinyl series The “Last Crusades” LP is part of Alfa Matrix Essentials, a vinyl reissue series tied to the label’s 25th anniversary that brings catalogue albums to the format for the first time. Star Industry previously received the same treatment in 2020, when their 1997 debut album, “Iron Dust Crush,” was issued on vinyl for the first time. The band is currently working on a new studio album, scheduled for March 2027. About Star Industry Star Industry formed in 1996 in Maasmechelen, Belgium, when Arts Academy friends Peter Beckers, Stijn Kuijpers and Xavier Vranken united around a shared interest in early New Wave music. Marc Haerden (drums) and Peter Gerits (synths) joined shortly after, and the band recorded its debut material at Galaxy Studio. Star Industry played its first concert on April 12, 1998, at the Black Easter Festival in Ghent. The band’s debut album, “Iron Dust Crush,” was released independently in 1997 and later picked up by Purple Moon Records; its single “Nineties” topped Israel’s alternative chart the following year. A “New Millennium E.P.” followed in 1999 on the EuroRock Festival label, the same year drummer Kurt Lantin replaced Marc Haerden. The band’s second full-length album, “Velvet,” arrived in 2001. “Last Crusades,” released in 2007, marked Star Industry’s move to Alfa Matrix, followed by the live album “Black Angel White Devil,” recorded in Madrid in 2008. The band toured China in 2011, playing Hong Kong, Shanghai and Beijing, and made its United States debut at New York’s Tammany Hall in 2012. Synth player Rich Vanderhoven replaced Peter Gerits in 2015, the same year the band released the “Eilyne E.P.” and the album “The Renegade,” recorded at Motor Music Studio. Star Industry contributed a cover of “Stripped” to Alfa Matrix’s 2019 Depeche Mode tribute compilation. Co-founder and bassist Stijn Kuijpers died in 2021. Rich Vanderhoven moved from synths to bass, and Joël Vranken joined the band on synths. Star Industry’s current lineup is Peter Beckers (vocals, guitar), Xavier Vranken (lead guitar), Kurt Lantin (drums), Rich Vanderhoven (bass) and Joël Vranken (synths). The band has said its focus since Kuijpers’ death has been on completing a new studio album, due in March 2027.

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.
